proposed_widenings.name: created_structure
proposed_widenings.justification: The item creates a persistent, damageable tower with its own geometry, access controls, retained damage, and revert conditions. Existing magic-item families cover passive grants, activations, reactions, spawned creatures, and composites of those, but not a created object/structure payload with ongoing object-state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty.

proposed_widenings.name: object_displacement_on_structure_creation
proposed_widenings.justification: The tower's appearance deterministically pushes creatures and unattended objects out of its footprint. Current attachments/effects can force-move creatures, but there is no honest surface shape for 'on creation, evacuate occupied footprint and clear unattended objects from the new structure area.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are also pushed clear of the tower.

notes: No honest content encoding was authored. The missing fit is not just a single atom; the unit needs a persistent created-object/structure family with revert, occupancy, and object-state semantics.
